hooks.command: /bin/sh -lc 'sound="${CODEX_PERMISSION_CHIME_SOUND:-/System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff}"; if [ -r "$sound" ] && command -v afplay >/dev/null 2>&1; then (afplay "$sound" >/dev/null 2>&1 &); elif command -v osascript >/dev/null 2>&1; then (osascript -e "beep 1" >/dev/null 2>&1 &); else printf "\a" >/dev/tty 2>/dev/null || true; fi'
